description:
Once the provider behaviour is proven against Anthropic, add the rest. Each is a self-contained codec module; no agent-side changes needed.

Scope (children to be created when we approach this phase):
- OpenAI Responses provider.
- Google Generative AI provider.
- Amazon Bedrock (Converse Stream API) — complex auth: profile / static creds / bearer / ECS / IRSA chain.
- Cross-provider message normalization (tool-id regex differences, thinking block coercion, image-downgrade for non-vision models).
- Cross-provider handoff integration tests.

Ref: RESEARCH.md §3.1, §6 Phase 5. Upstream's Provider plug-in pattern is in AGENTS.md "Adding a New LLM Provider" — mirror the structure.
title: Phase 5: additional providers (OpenAI, Google, Bedrock)
